secrets.description: Firebase Web API key for project gen-lang-client-0564368936 (Firebase console -> Project settings -> General -> Web app config -> apiKey). The key committed in firebase-applet-config.json is redacted, so Firebase Auth sign-in, Firestore real-time sync and Storage uploads fail without it. The UI still renders from its local cached data.
